blocks.text: Name: Dr. Ashish PanchalEmail: apanchal@ietdavv.edu.inPhone: +91-969124362436Address: 100 D Sudama Nagar Indore

Ph.D. holder specializing in low-power SRAM cell design for portable device applications. Expertise in CMOS circuit design, memory architecture, and power optimization techniques. Strong background in analytical modeling, simulation, and performance optimization of SRAM cells with a focus on stability, power efficiency, and scalability.
Ph.D. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
SAGE University, 2026
Thesis: “DESIGN AND PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS OF SRAM MEMORY CELL FOR LOW POWER APPLICATION
M.Tech in Microelectronics & VLSI Design
SGSITS Indore, 2011
B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
RGPV Bhopal, 2008
Low Power SRAM Design
Memory Architecture
CMOS Analog & Digital Design
Emerging Memory Technologies
Low Voltage and Energy-Efficient Circuits
Tools: Cadence Virtuoso, HSPICE, LTspice, TinaPro, MultiSim.
Technologies: CMOS (90nm and beyond), FinFET basics
Concepts: Analog and Digital circuit design and various simulations like SNM analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, Low-power techniques, Read/Write stability analysis
Designed a novel low-power SRAM cell architecture with improved:
Static Voltage Noise Margin (SVNM)
Write Trip Voltage (WTV)
Reduced read/write delay
Lower dynamic and leakage power
Developed analytical models incorporating stacked NMOS effects
Proposed enhanced read-decoupled architecture for stability improvement
Performed extensive simulations including Monte Carlo analysis
